methods.name: Logit and probit as stats::glm (IRLS), with aliasing, separation and outcome-domain handling
methods.reference: stats::glm(family = binomial('logit' | 'probit')) at glm.control(epsilon = 1e-10, maxit = 100); summary.glm; tight refit at epsilon = 1e-14; R's default control for the separated case
quantities: aliased coefficients NA and the rank
separation flag and warnings (p2a's and R's default control)
limit of the identified coefficients of a quasi-separated fit
methods.tolerance: logit at epsilon 1e-10 (the MLE to 1e-13) and probit at epsilon 1e-14: coefficients 1e-8, SEs, z, logLik, AIC 1e-6, p 1e-6 + 1e-12 (validation/README.md, n = 400); the default-control probit 1e-6 against the tight MLE; quasi-separated limit coefficients 1e-6 and SEs 1e-5; near-collinear fit 1e-6

deviations.note: MleSettings defaults to max_iter 100, tolerance 1e-10 (R glm.control: 25, 1e-8); at R's default probit stops 1.6e-6 from the MLE on disc_choice_na; R's values remain settable
